attributes.context: The provision appears in Article IV, Section 1, Efficiency of Operations, which states that LOCAL UNION shall encourage journeymen plumbers and apprentices to accomplish results and also limits the assignment of apprentices so that no more than one apprentice is assigned to a journeyman.

extraction_text: There shall be no restrictions as to the amount of work journeymen plumbers and apprentices shall do, nor shall there be any restrictions as to the use of labor saving machinery for the installation of any work; provided that the aforesaid machinery meets with the approval of the Conference Committee.

attributes.context: The clause appears under Article VI, Section 1, titled Fabrication of Pipe-Tools, and is followed in the same article by provisions on small-pipe fabrication, responsibility for plumbing work, and subletting of work.

extraction_text: Both parties agree that all pipe shall be fabricated by machine and with tools operated and handled by journeymen plumbers, and they shall be paid no less than the hourly wage rate for journeymen plumbers as set forth in ARTICLE III, Section 1 of this Agreement. No journeyman plumber or apprentice shall be permitted to furnish tools.

attributes.context: This appears in Appendix A, a Memorandum of Agreement between the Mechanical Contractors Association of Eastern Pennsylvania and Local Union 690, and is followed by a provision stating that there shall be no limitations on worker productivity or on full use of tools of the trade and construction equipment.

extraction_text: The contractor shall have the responsibility to efficiently manage his portion of the job including the supplying of sufficient tools and equipment with which to carry out the needed installation and the scheduling of an adequate number of workmen to meet job requirements and conditions. The direction of the working force, the right to hire, to plan, direct, control, and schedule all operations, in cooperation with other trades and the specified requirements of the User, shall be the responsibility of the contractor, including the right to establish, eliminate, change, or introduce methods, machinery, or techniques to efficiently perform all tasks.
